VALIDATION_FAILED.title: Request validation failed
VALIDATION_FAILED.description: The request breaks the operation's schema or a field rule; `errors[]` names each failing field by JSON pointer (doc 06 §2).

UNAUTHENTICATED.title: Authentication required
UNAUTHENTICATED.description: The operation's credential is missing or not accepted: the access token (platform.yaml `Unauthenticated`), or the token the operation carries in its body, query or header.

FORBIDDEN.title: Forbidden
FORBIDDEN.description: The caller is authenticated but may not perform this operation, including one that needs a recent sign-in (identity.yaml `RecentSignInRequired`); a more specific 403 code wins where the operation names one (platform.yaml `Forbidden`).

NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
NOT_FOUND.description: The resource does not exist for the caller, or the route is unknown.

CONFLICT.title: Conflict
CONFLICT.description: The request conflicts with the stored state and no more specific 409 code applies; also any repeated `Idempotency-Key` on an operation marked `x-idempotency-replay: never` (platform.yaml `Conflict`).

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.title: Idempotency key reused with a different request
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.description: Idempotency-Key replayed with a different body (doc 06 §2).

VERSION_MISMATCH.title: Resource version mismatch
VERSION_MISMATCH.description: `If-Match` version mismatch; body carries the current state (doc 06 §2).

ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED.title: Entitlement required
ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED.description: Feature gated by an entitlement the caller lacks (doc 06 §2, doc 12).

AGE_GATE_FAILED.title: Minimum age not met
AGE_GATE_FAILED.description: Signup refused below the minimum age (DEC-60). 403, not 400: the refusal is terminal, so a client must not offer to re-enter the birth year (P03 phase §5).

CONSENT_REQUIRED.title: Consent required
CONSENT_REQUIRED.description: Needs a consent purpose the caller has not granted, or refuses the withdrawal of a purpose the person cannot withdraw (`withdrawable: false`; `core_service` today, which the app requires) (doc 11 §7.2); 403 like ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED.

MEASUREMENT_IMPLAUSIBLE.title: Measurement outside the accepted range
MEASUREMENT_IMPLAUSIBLE.description: A measurement outside its hard bounds (registry/measurement-definitions.json; doc 07 §3.3 severity 1): refused, not stored. 400 like VALIDATION_FAILED, with `errors[]` naming the field; never echo the value (doc 11 §8).

CONTEXT_STALE.title: Context is stale
CONTEXT_STALE.description: Context facts too old to decide on (doc 06 §2).

ACCOUNT_DELETED.title: Account deleted
ACCOUNT_DELETED.description: Account is deleted or deletion is in progress (doc 06 §8).

CONTENT_TOO_LARGE.title: Content too large
CONTENT_TOO_LARGE.description: Request body larger than the endpoint accepts (RFC 9110 §15.5.14).

UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.title: Unsupported media type
UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.description: Request body `Content-Type` the endpoint does not accept (RFC 9110 §15.5.16).

RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many requests
RATE_LIMITED.description: A rate limit was hit (doc 11 §14); retry after `Retry-After` seconds (platform.yaml `RateLimited`).

INTERNAL.title: Internal error
INTERNAL.description: An unexpected server error; the body never carries internals or a provider error body (doc 06 §2).

SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.title: Service unavailable
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.description: A checked dependency (db, provider) is down; health returns this with `checks` (doc 06 §2).
